samples.hyp:

Ucwaningo, olushicilelwe ku-Journal of Global Health, luhlaziya ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezinto zokuvimbela inzalo kungase kuthinte kanjani ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19 emadolobheni amakhulu ase-Afrika. samples.src: Abacwaningi bathi izindlela zamanje ezisetshenziswayo ukubikezela ukuthi umuntu uzoba nesifo sofuzo noma cha azisebenzi kahle kubantu bomdabu wase-Afrika.
samples.ref: Researchers say that current methods used to predict whether or not a person will develop a genetic disease doesn’t work well for people of African origin.
samples.hyp:
Abacwaningi base-UKZN, e-University of Cambridge nase-University of Sussex baveza lokhu ocwaningweni lwabo olushicilelwe kwi-American Journal of Human Genetics.

Abacwaningi bahlola ukuthi izindlela ezisetshenziswayo zokubikezela ukuthi umuntu uzoba nesifo sofuzo noma cha zisebenza kanjani kubantu bomdabu wase-Afrika. Abacwaningi basebenzise idatha yezofuzo yabantu abangama-3 416 abavela e-Afrika, abangama-5 173 abavela e-Europe nabangama-2 126 abavela e-East Asia. Bathole ukuthi izindlela zamanje zokubikezela ukuthi umuntu uzoba nesifo sofuzo noma cha azisebenzi kahle kubantu bomdabu wase-Afrika. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izifo eziningi ezithathelwanayo ezibangela ukuthi umuntu abe nesifo sofuzo zivamile kubantu bomdabu wase-Afrika, kodwa izindlela zamanje zokubikezela ukuthi umuntu uzoba nesifo sofuzo noma cha azibheki izifo ezithathelwanayo.

Umfundi weziqu ze-PhD e-UKZN uDkt Sinead Kelly, uthe: ‘Ucwaningo lwethu lukhombisa ukuthi izindlela zamanje zokubikezela ukuthi umuntu uzoba nesifo sofuzo noma cha azisebenzi kahle kubantu bomdabu wase-Afrika. Umbhalo wesiNgisi:
The pharmacokinetic (PK) properties of oral and intravenous (IV) rifampicin were investigated in 22 and 20 patients with tuberculosis meningitis (TBM), respectively. The mean (SD) dose administered was 10.5 (2.7) g/day for the oral route and 600 (0.18) mg/kg for the IV route. Area under the concentration-time curve (AUC), peak concentration (Cmax), time to peak concentration (Tmax), elimination half-life (T1/2), and clearance (Cl) were calculated. The mean AUC and Cmax values were 28.9 (SD 9.33) μM.h and 22.2 (SD 5.1) μM, respectively, for the oral route and 39.1 (SD 13.3) μM.h and 29.6 (SD 8.1) μM, respectively, for the IV route. The Tmax value was 3.3 (SD 1.8) h. The mean T1/2 and Cl values were 2.12 (SD 0.33) h and 27.78 (SD 8.80) L/h, respectively. There was a significant difference in the AUC and Cmax values between the oral and IV routes (p = 0.001). No significant difference was found in the Tmax, T1/2, and Cl values between the two routes. The oral route resulted in lower AUC and Cmax values than the IV route; however, the difference in the clearance value was not significant. The low bioavailability of rifampicin in TBM patients administered high doses via the oral route and the resulting lower plasma concentrations may be due to gastrointestinal side effects and hepatic dysfunction.
